newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Nov overseas investment approvals fall.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Nov overseas investment approvals fall.

text.p: Approvals for overseas investment by South Korean companies totalled $334.4 million in November, down from $437.2 million a year ago, the central Bank of Korea (BOK) said on Monday.
The bank said in a statement it was the second consecutive year-on-year decline in monthly figures, following a sharp fall to $453 million in October from $825 million in October 1995.
But approvals for the first 11 months of this year rose to $5.05 billion from $3.96 billion a year earlier, it said.
During the 11-month period, approvals for investment in Asia excluding the Middle East region totalled $2.73 billion, up from $2.14 billion a year earlier.
North America drew $1.02 billion worth of investment approvals during the 11-month period, up from a year earlier's $906.2 million.
The statement said actual overseas investments made between January and November totalled $3.64 billion, up from $2.79 billion for the comparable 1995 period.
